fact_types.title: Bond premium reported in box 11 of one logical Form 1099-INT statement instance furnished by a payer for 2025 on a taxable bond, for a taxpayer who did not elect to net premium against the reported box-1/box-3 interest amount; statement identity is peer to evidence and carries no file, upload, scan, document, or evidence key (ADR-0015). This product records the recognized fact only: it does not amortize the premium, does not net it against any interest subtotal, and does not yet translate it into any Schedule B adjustment or return consequence.

label: Form 1099-INT box-11 bond-premium recognition vocabulary for tax year 2025 (recognized, not yet translated)
